name: Hatori Airu
source:
A girl with a quiet demeanor that makes little changes in her expression. She is usually quiet, but when she opens her mouth, she tends to speak with harsh words. However, she doesn't mean to be malicious, just brutally honest, so she is perceived as a kind of an airhead.

She always wears dark black stockings and rarely shows her bare skin. In reality, she yearns to be a normal girl, to talk and fall in love. She comes to the school with a certain purpose, and becomes deeply involved with Takuto.

[spoiler]Ability: Simple Word
The ability to see-through lies. Although if she herself lies, a snake tattoo gets progressively closer to her heart each time she lies, until she dies. [/spoiler]

"I'm not sleepy... It's just that this topic is boring."
